rationale: Standalone searchable CZ tender mirror useful as VVZ/NEN fallback, but commercial third-party with unclear reuse terms — confirm legal status before approving.
Single operator page documenting Prague contactless/terminal rollout with supplier names — good evidence artifact, not a recurring signal stream.
One individual NEN tender record exemplifying CIT/cash-processing phrasing; value is as a query pattern, with NEN itself the monitored parent.
Authoritative ČNB register of all licensed banks, payment and e-money institutions — ground truth for enumerating CZ payment actors.
Official machine-readable JERRS web service — the sustainable long-term collection channel for the payment-actor register.
EBA credit-institutions register with bulk download; cleanest way to track CZ bank and branch entries/exits.
Index of EBA registers — mine once to enumerate the PSD2/crowdfunding registers worth monitoring individually.
Residual ČNB list index sitting under the already-monitored cnb.cz supervisory-lists parent; adds no standalone feed.
Continuously updated enforcement-decision database with adversarial quantitative disclosure on payment institutions.
Static legal-reference index within cnb.cz; useful schema context but produces few new signals on its own.
Searchable ÚOHS decision collection; antitrust files on interchange, ATM and acquiring expose fees and market shares.
ÚOHS payments topic page is a section of the monitored uohs.gov.cz domain — best used to scope queries against the decision database.
Merger notification and decision series gives early warning on banking/acquiring/ATM deals plus market-definition data.
Regulator press-release feed surfacing payment-market findings ahead of full decision publication; low-cost continuous monitor.
Annual Financial Arbitrator reports give a recurring statistical series on payment-service and card dispute volumes.
Valuable full-text ADR decision database on payment disputes, but legal_status unclear on republishing anonymised findings — clarify reuse terms.
Ministry's annual financial-market report is a long-running authoritative series covering payments infrastructure and aggregates.
A single 2016 explanatory memorandum PDF with RIA figures — cite as evidence; the ministry legislative section is the monitored parent.
Government service-catalogue entry defining arbitrator jurisdiction; useful interpretive context, no independent signal flow.
English mirror of an already-covered ČNB payments section; keep for terminology mapping, not as a separate monitored source.
